message: Inventory seeded: 192 user stories across 7 areas
Starting phase 1: automated API + UI + Go test sweep
→ blocked — Native Fyne window geometry; needs an interactive desktop session.
→ blocked — In-process API bind before window; exercised by the desktop smoke run, not the headless rig.
→ blocked — Ephemeral 48-hex token minting lives in the desktop main; verified by code inspection only.
→ blocked — Single-instance IPC needs two GUI launches.
→ blocked — Window geometry restore needs MyGO state persistence across GUI launches.
→ blocked — Close lifecycle needs the GUI event loop.
→ blocked — Native bind-failure dialog needs a display and a forced port conflict.
→ blocked — Native Accept/Reject pairing dialog needs the GUI prompt.
→ blocked — Dock.SetIcon needs a macOS app bundle; not exercised headlessly.
→ blocked — -smoke needs the built desktop binary (shell module, go1.27.1) and a display.
→ blocked — Desktop -no-sync flag; the headless serve --no-sync path is covered by CLI-05/CLI-18.
→ blocked — Desktop -addr override; the equivalent listen override is covered by CLI-20.
→ blocked — Desktop -data-dir override; the equivalent is covered by CLI-19.
→ blocked — Trigger coalescing try-lock has no dedicated test; the lock itself is covered by SYNC-10/11.
→ blocked — Needs a live Joplin Server; the HTTP client paths are shared with the tested Dropbox/S3 drivers.
→ blocked — Real S3 backend needs -tags s3 and AWS credentials; the default stub compiles into the binary.
→ blocked — Store-level settings KV has no unit test; the service seam is covered by SVC-05.
→ blocked — item_changes paging is exercised through the API (API-45) rather than a store unit test.
→ blocked — dropbox-auth needs an interactive OAuth redirect against Dropbox; the loopback flow is unit tested (TestDropboxOAuth_LoopbackFlow).
